column1: # Purpose: declare Git repositories needed by dotfiles, in dependency order.
# id: a unique label using only letters, digits, _ or -.
# url: an HTTPS URL or git@host:path SSH URL, without embedded credentials.
# target: a unique path relative to HOME; no absolute path, empty segment, . or .. segment.
# revision: a full lowercase 40-character commit SHA, or the literal tracking.
# Pinned revisions require a clean checkout and forward ancestry when changing HEAD.
# tracking: clone the default branch, then use its upstream with pull --ff-only.
# shell: all, bash, zsh or fish; matched against the basename of the login SHELL.
# Existing targets must be exact Git worktree roots with the exact declared origin URL.
# Dirty tracking checkouts are preserved and reported; pinned dirty checkouts fail.
# Blank lines and lines beginning with # are ignored. No inline comments or quoting.
# Use literal TAB separators; spaces in paths are literal and must not pad fields.
